text: IT Security Policy Employees must use strong passwords for all company accounts. Multi-factor authentication is required for all remote access. Company laptops must be locked whenever employees leave their desks. Employees must report suspected security incidents to the IT department immediately.

Business Expense Policy Employees may claim reasonable travel expenses incurred for approved business trips. Expense claims should be submitted within 30 days of the expense. Receipts are required for reimbursable expenses. Managers must approve business expense claims before reimbursement.

Company Annual Leave Policy Employees receive 30 days of annual leave per calendar year. Employees should request annual leave through the company's HR system. Unused annual leave may be carried over to the following year, subject to company policy. Employees should normally request leave at least two weeks in advance. Remote Work Policy Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Employees working remotely must remain available during their agreed working hours.
